result.instructions: Tools for RSS.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my podcasts and their draft episodes."; "Create a draft episode with these show notes and add three chapters."; "Publish episode 42 as soon as its audio has finished processing.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RSS.com data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rsscom_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rsscom_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rsscom_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rsscom_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rsscom_list_podcasts
tools.title: List podcasts
tools.description: List the podcasts on the account with their ids, titles, language, cover and timestamps. Start here to get a podcast_id. RSS API: GET /v4/podcasts.

tools.name: rsscom_get_podcast
tools.title: Get a podcast
tools.description: Get one podcast by id: title, language, cover, redirect URL, hibernation state and timestamps. RSS API: GET /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}.

tools.name: rsscom_list_episodes
tools.title: List episodes
tools.description: List the episodes of a podcast, newest or oldest first, optionally filtered by status (draft, scheduled, published) or a search string. RSS API: GET /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes.

tools.name: rsscom_get_episode
tools.title: Get an episode
tools.description: Get one episode: title, notes, status, schedule and publish times, audio and video URLs, processing state and assigned keywords. RSS API: GET /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes/{episode_id}.

tools.name: rsscom_create_episode
tools.title: Create an episode
tools.description: Create one draft episode on a podcast. It is not published until rsscom_publish_episode sets a schedule. Creates one episode per call. RSS API: POST /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes.

itunes_explicit.description: Explicit content flag. null clears it.

custom_link.description: Website link for the episode in the RSS feed.

cover_upload_id.description: Cover image upload id from rsscom_create_presigned_upload.

tools.name: rsscom_edit_episode
tools.title: Edit an episode
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on one episode; fields you leave out stay as they are. Does not change the guid. RSS API: PATCH /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/episodes/{episode_id}.

itunes_explicit.description: Explicit content flag. null clears it.

custom_link.description: Website link for the episode in the RSS feed.

cover_upload_id.description: Cover image upload id from rsscom_create_presigned_upload.

schedule_datetime.description: Publish time. null removes the schedule.

anyOf.description: Date and time with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-07T09:00:00Z.

tools.name: rsscom_publish_episode
tools.title: Publish an episode
tools.description: Publish an episode by setting its schedule. With no time, it uses the current time, so the episode publishes as soon as transcoding finishes. RSS API: PATCH .../episodes/{episode_id} with schedule_datetime.

schedule_datetime.description: Publish time. Leave out to publish as soon as possible.

tools.name: rsscom_unschedule_episode
tools.title: Unschedule an episode
tools.description: Remove the publish schedule from an episode so it is no longer set to publish. RSS API: PATCH .../episodes/{episode_id} with schedule_datetime null.

tools.name: rsscom_list_chapters
tools.title: List chapters
tools.description: List the chapters of an episode with start time, duration, title and link. RSS API: GET .../episodes/{episode_id}/chapters.

tools.name: rsscom_create_chapter
tools.title: Create a chapter
tools.description: Add one chapter to an episode at a start time with a duration, both in milliseconds. RSS API: POST .../episodes/{episode_id}/chapters.

start_time_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the episode.

cover_upload_id.description: Chapter image upload id from rsscom_create_presigned_upload.

tools.name: rsscom_edit_chapter
tools.title: Edit a chapter
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on one chapter. RSS API: PATCH .../episodes/{episode_id}/chapters/{chapter_id}.

start_time_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the episode.

duration_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the episode.

cover_upload_id.description: Chapter image upload id from rsscom_create_presigned_upload.

tools.name: rsscom_list_soundbites
tools.title: List soundbites
tools.description: List the soundbites (short promo clips) of an episode with start time, duration and title. RSS API: GET .../episodes/{episode_id}/soundbites.

tools.name: rsscom_create_soundbite
tools.title: Create a soundbite
tools.description: Add one soundbite clip to an episode: start time, duration and title, all in one call. RSS API: POST .../episodes/{episode_id}/soundbites.

start_time_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the episode.

tools.name: rsscom_edit_soundbite
tools.title: Edit a soundbite
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on one soundbite. RSS API: PATCH .../episodes/{episode_id}/soundbites/{soundbite_id}.

start_time_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the episode.

duration_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the episode.

tools.name: rsscom_list_midrolls
tools.title: List midroll ad breaks
tools.description: List the midroll ad break positions of an episode. RSS API: GET .../episodes/{episode_id}/midrolls.

tools.name: rsscom_create_midroll
tools.title: Create a midroll ad break
tools.description: Add one midroll ad break to an episode at a start time. RSS API: POST .../episodes/{episode_id}/midrolls.

start_time_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the episode.

tools.name: rsscom_edit_midroll
tools.title: Move a midroll ad break
tools.description: Move one midroll ad break to a new start time. RSS API: PATCH .../episodes/{episode_id}/midrolls/{midroll_id}.

start_time_ms.description: Time in milliseconds from the start of the episode.

tools.name: rsscom_get_transcript
tools.title: Get a transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript of an episode: the text, its format (vtt, srt or txt) and its publishing status. RSS API: GET .../episodes/{episode_id}/transcript.

tools.name: rsscom_save_transcript
tools.title: Save a transcript
tools.description: Replace the transcript of an episode with the text you pass (vtt, srt or txt). The previous transcript is overwritten. RSS API: PUT .../episodes/{episode_id}/transcript.

format.description: The format of the transcription text.

tools.name: rsscom_generate_transcript
tools.title: Generate a transcript
tools.description: Start automatic transcript generation for an episode from its audio, as vtt or srt. Higher quality takes longer. Check rsscom_get_transcript first if one already exists. RSS API: POST .../episodes/{episode_id}/transcript/generate.

format.description: The format of the generated transcript.

quality.description: Low is fastest; high is most accurate.

tools.name: rsscom_list_keywords
tools.title: List keywords
tools.description: List the keywords of a podcast with their ids. Use the ids in keyword_ids when you create or edit an episode. RSS API: GET /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/keywords.

tools.name: rsscom_create_keyword
tools.title: Create a keyword
tools.description: Add one keyword to a podcast. Returns its id for keyword_ids. RSS API: POST /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/keywords.

tools.name: rsscom_search_locations
tools.title: Search locations
tools.description: Search the location list by text (at least 3 characters). Returns location ids for the location fields. RSS API: GET /v4/locations?filter=.

filter.description: Text to match a location name (at least 3 characters).

tools.name: rsscom_list_categories
tools.title: List Apple categories
tools.description: List the Apple Podcasts category ids and names. RSS API: GET /v4/categories.

tools.name: rsscom_list_txt_records
tools.title: List TXT records
tools.description: List the DNS TXT records registered for a podcast (for example, a verification record). RSS API: GET /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/txt.

tools.name: rsscom_create_txt_record
tools.title: Create a TXT record
tools.description: Add one TXT record value to a podcast, with an optional purpose such as verify. RSS API: POST /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/txt.

tools.name: rsscom_edit_txt_record
tools.title: Edit a TXT record
tools.description: Change the value or purpose of one TXT record. RSS API: PATCH /v4/podcasts/{podcast_id}/txt/{txt_record_id}.

purpose.description: Purpose, for example verify. null clears it.

tools.name: rsscom_create_presigned_upload
tools.title: Create an upload URL
tools.description: Get a one-time upload URL for an audio or image file. Send the file with one HTTP PUT to the returned url, using the expected_mime as Content-Type. Then pass the returned id as audio_upload_id or cover_upload_id. Multipart uploads are not in this tool. RSS API: POST .../assets/presigned-uploads.

expected_mime.description: The file MIME type, for example audio/mpeg or image/jpeg.

filename.description: The file name, for example episode-12.mp3.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with RSS.com
prompts.description: What you can do with RSS.com here, with example requests to try.
